answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7439 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to ask that giving eidi is jaiz,eating halwa on the day of shabrat,and the salaamiya(money which are given to bride and groom)is jaiz or not.my questions are some what confusing but i want to konw the anwsers becoz i cant get them in any of the book. Question: salam... I want to ask that giving eidi is jaiz,eating halwa on the day of shabrat,and the salaamiya(money which are given to bride and groom)is jaiz or not.my questions are some what confusing but i want to konw the anwsers becoz i cant get them in any of the book.jazakALLAH Answer ID: 7439 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1690/1470=B /1429) There is no wrong to give Eid gift to children on the occasion of Eid. The custom of cooking and eating halwa on the day of shab-e-baraat has intruded to us from Shias, they celebrate it as the birthday of Imam Ghayeb; we should avoid adopting their custom. Giving salaami money is a customary thing, it is a gift as per the Shariah, there is nothing wrong. One should accept whatever is given, there should be no demand. Also, one should not make it a regular custom. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
